SELECT h.id as history_id, h.deployment_id, s.title as deployment_title, h.type, h.status, h.create_by, h.start_time, h.backup_path, d.metadata_type, d.member_name, d.action, d.diff_content FROM sf_deployment_history_detail d LEFT JOIN sf_deployment_history h ON d.history_id = h.id LEFT JOIN sf_deployment s ON h.deployment_id = s.id
AND d.metadata_type = #{type}
AND d.member_name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY h.start_time DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%m-%d') as dateStr, COUNT(*) as countVal FROM sf_deployment_history WHERE start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY dateStr ASC
SELECT status as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM sf_deployment_history GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sf_deployment_history WHERE YEARWEEK(start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sf_deployment_history WHERE status = 'Succeeded'
SELECT h.*, s.title as deploymentTitle FROM sf_deployment_history h LEFT JOIN sf_deployment s ON h.deployment_id = s.id ORDER BY h.start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
